Name: Hidden Power Of The Swarm
Effect: Successive Actions. Choose a Damage-Type for each attack you are making and apply the correlating effect. Bug, Dragon, Fairy, Fighting, Flying, Ground, Normal, Rock, Steel, Water: Add +1 Damage Dice. Dark: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe. Ghost: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Foe. Electric: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Foe. Grass: Roll 2 Chance Dice to *Leech the Foe. Poison: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Poison the Foe. Psychic: Roll 2 Chance Dice to put the Foe to Sleep. Fire: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Burn (1) the Foe. Ice: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Frostbite (1) the Foe.
Description: The swarm launches many strange powers at the Foe.
